create_nomic_bert_config: create a NomicBertConfig instance with default nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 style configuration
build_nomic_bert_model: build a NomicBertModel from a NomicBertConfig instance with random weights
access_model_config: access a model's configuration via the model.config attribute
run_masked_lm_forward: run a NomicBertForMaskedLM forward pass on input tokens and compute masked language modeling loss
classify_sequence: classify a sequence with NomicBertForSequenceClassification using pooled output and a linear classifier head
perform_token_classification: perform token classification with NomicBertForTokenClassification on per-token hidden states
initialize_attention_projection: initialize NomicBertAttention with query key value and output projection layers using config hidden size and head dim
apply_prediction_head_transform: apply NomicBertPredictionHeadTransform dense activation and layer norm to hidden states
